item.title: groff: 1.24.1 -> 1.24.2
item.description:
"Th[e] release resolves recently discovered security vulnerabilities affecting all groff releases dating back to 2012, and even farther. … Th[e] release corrects command injection security vulnerabilities (CWE-78) in the mmroff, pdfmom, and pre-grohtml programs. The last of these is a preprocessor that is run when groff or troff is run with the -T html or -T xhtml options. The vulnerabilities are variously 14-26 years old. Malicious input can escape groff's default "safer" mode, running commands embedded in that input at the user's privilege level. The groff development team recommends this release to any users who employ the named tools or GNU troff output formats with untrusted inputs.

Man page rendering is not vulnerable unless rendering (X)HTML."

—  https://lists.gnu.org/archive/html/groff/2026-09/msg00090.html
